vicfalls.name: I-Victoria Falls
vicfalls.desc: Enye yezimangaliso eziyisikhombisa zemvelo emhlabeni, impophoma enkulu kakhulu emhlabeni.
vicfalls.summary: Eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi yi-Mosi-oa-Tunya (Intuthu Edumayo), iVictoria Falls iyiphinda kabili ukuphakama kwe-Niagara Falls. Thola ithuba lokugibela izikepe, ukugxuma ngetambo (bungee jumping), lokubuka impophoma ngendizamtshina.
quickFacts: Located on the Zambezi River at the Zimbabwe-Zambia border.
Approximate width is 1.7 km with a drop of over 100 m at its deepest sections.
Protected within the Mosi-oa-Tunya / Victoria Falls World Heritage landscape.
experiences: Scenic viewpoints, rainforest walks, and photography trails.
Adventure options such as rafting, bungee jumping, and helicopter flights.
Nearby safari and river experiences in surrounding protected areas.
vicfalls.bestTime: Umbukwane wamanzi aphezulu uvame ukuba namandla kakhulu kusukela enkathini yemvula ngasekupheleni kwenkathi eyomile; izinyanga ezinamanzi aphansi zivame ukuncanyelwa kwezinye zemisebenzi yokuzijabulisa.

greatzim.name: IZimbabwe Enkulu
greatzim.desc: Izinsalela zamatshe zasendulo ezibonisa impucuko yase-Africa yasendulo lobuchwepheshe bokwakha.
greatzim.summary: Yakhwa phakathi kwekhulu le-11 le-15, iGreat Zimbabwe yayiyimfunda-nkulu yombuso weZimbabwe. Izakhiwo zamatshe ezinkulu zakhiwa ngaphandle kokusebenzisa usimende (mortar).
quickFacts: Constructed and expanded between the 11th and 15th centuries.
Famous for dry-stone masonry built without mortar.
Represents the political and cultural center of the historic Zimbabwe civilization.
experiences: Explore the Hill Complex, Great Enclosure, and Valley Ruins.
Interpretive historical tours and local cultural storytelling.
Panoramic viewpoints over the wider Masvingo landscape.
greatzim.bestTime: Kufinyeleleka unyaka wonke; izinyanga zenkathi eyomile ngokuvamile zingcono ukuhamba nokuhlola indawo.

kariba.name: Kariba Dam
kariba.desc: Enye yamachibi amakhulu kakhulu emhlabeni akhiwe ngabantu, alungele ukuhamba ngezikepe-zindlu lokudoba.
kariba.summary: Ichibi laseKariba lidonsa amakhilomitha angaphezu kuka-5,500 square kilometers eduze komfula uZambezi. Laziwa kakhulu ngokudoba i-tiger fish, amaholide ezikepe-zindlu, lokubuka ilanga lishona.
quickFacts: Sits on the Zambezi corridor and supports both tourism and recreation.
Popular for boat-based travel, fishing tourism, and sunset cruises.
Connected to nearby wildlife areas including Matusadona-facing zones.
experiences: Game-viewing combinations with lake and park circuits.
kariba.bestTime: Isikhathi esomile sithandwa kakhulu ekubukweni kwezilwane zasendle; imisebenzi yechibi isebenza cishe unyaka wonke.

rocks.name: Amatshe agidliselene (Balancing Rocks)
rocks.desc: Amatshe emvelo aveleleyo afanekisela amagugu eZimbabwe ayingqayizivele.
rocks.summary: Lawa matshe anqoba amandla okudonsela phansi avela emalini yeZimbabwe njalo atholakala elizweni lonke, ikakhulu eMatobo National Park.
quickFacts: Prominent around Matobo and other granite landscapes.
Featured in national symbolism, including currency imagery.
Formed through weathering and erosion of ancient granite outcrops.
experiences: Landscape photography and short nature walks.
Rock-art and heritage combinations in Matobo areas.
Scenic drives linking Harare and Matobo viewpoints.
rocks.bestTime: Ukukhangwa unyaka wonke; isimo sezulu esicacile sesizini esomile ngokuvamile sinikeza ukubonakala okungcono kakhulu kwezithombe.

tourism.other_attractions_subtitle: Ngaphandle kwezindawo eziveleleyo, iZimbabwe inezinhlobonhlobo zezindawo lezinyamazana elizweni lonke.

hwange.name: Hwange National Park
hwange.desc: Isiqiwu esikhulu kunazo zonke eZimbabwe, esaziwa ngemihlambi yendlovu emikhulu.
hwange.summary: Ihlanganisa indawo engaphezu kuka-14,000 square kilometers, iHwange yindawo yokuqala ye-safari. Inemihlobo yezilwane ezincancisayo engaphezu kuka-100 lemihlobo yenyoni engu-400.
hwange.bestTime: Izinga eliphakeme lezilwane zasendle livame ukuba ezinyangeni ezomile lapho imithombo yamanzi ilinganiselwe.

matobo.name: Matobo National Park
matobo.desc: Indawo ye-UNESCO World Heritage eyaziwa ngamatshe ayo agidliselene lomlando wokomoya.
matobo.summary: IMatobo Hills inezindawo ezingavamileyo zamatshe e-granite. Yindawo eqakathekileyo ye-archaeological enemifanekiso yama-San eminingi kakhulu e-Southern Africa.
matobo.bestTime: Kufinyeleleka unyaka wonke; izinyanga ezomile ezipholile zilungele ukuhamba nokuhlola.

eastern_highlands.name: I-Eastern Highlands
eastern_highlands.desc: Indawo eqandayo lezintaba eneziganga ezinhle, izimpophoma, leziqongo ezisibekelwe yinkungu.
eastern_highlands.summary: Idonsa emngceleni weMozambique, le ndawo ihlanganisa izintaba zeNyanga, Vumba, leChimanimani.
eastern_highlands.bestTime: Izinyanga ezomile ngokuvamile zinikeza ukubuka okucacile nezimo ezingcono zomzila.

mana_pools.name: I-Mana Pools National Park
mana_pools.desc: Indawo ye-UNESCO ekude eyaziwa ngamachibi ayo ondliwa ngumfula le-safari yokuhamba ngezinyawo.
mana_pools.summary: Itholakala e-Zambezi Valley, iMana Pools yaziwa ngobuhle bayo obumangalisayo lamachibi amane amakhulu akhiwa ngumfula.
mana_pools.bestTime: Isikhathi esomile sithandwa kakhulu ekubukweni kwezilwane zasendle eziminyana kakhulu.

nyanga.name: I-Nyanga National Park
nyanga.desc: I-'Little Scotland' yase-Africa, ikhaya lesiqongo esiphakeme kunazo zonke eZimbabwe nempophoma ejule kunazo zonke.
nyanga.summary: INyanga lipharadesi le-highland eliqoqa iMount Nyangani leMutarazi Falls (impophoma yesibili ngokuphakama e-Africa).
nyanga.bestTime: Indawo oya kuyo unyaka wonke; izikhathi zezulu ezicacile zingcono kakhulu ekubukeni kwezintaba.

gonarezhou.name: I-Gonarezhou National Park
gonarezhou.desc: I-'Indawo yezindlovu,' ebonakala ngamawa abomvu e-Chilojo Cliffs.
gonarezhou.summary: Njengesiqiwu sesibili ngobukhulu eZimbabwe, iGonarezhou yaziwa ngezindawo zayo ezinamagagasi lamawa amatshe abomvu (sandstone cliffs).
gonarezhou.bestTime: Izinyanga ezomile ngokuvamile zingcono kakhulu ekufinyeleleni nasekubukweni kwezilwane zasendle ezigxilile.

regulations.title: Isikhokhelo Semithetho Lokuhambisana
regulations.subtitle: Isikhokhelo esisebenzayo semithetho sabatshali bama-diaspora, abathumeli phandle, lababuyayo ekhaya. Sebenzisa lokhu njengohlu lokwenza umsebenzi, njalo uvumelanise izinqumo zokucina labacebisi abafaneleyo kwezomthetho, intela, lengxenye yebhizimusi.

investment_compliance.title: Ukuhambisana kokutshala imali
points: Qinisekisa uhlaka lomthetho lwephrojekthi, ubunikazi, lokulawulwa kwebhodi ngaphambi kokuxhaswa.
Qinisekisa amalayisensi lezimvumo nge-ZIDA kanye labalawuli bengxenye abafaneleyo.
Sebenzisa izivumelwano ezibhaliweyo zabaninimasheya lokuphathwa kwe-co-investment yama-diaspora.
Bhala umthombo wemali njalo wenze i-KYC/AML kubahlanganyeli.

currency_settlement.title: Imali, ukubuyiselwa kwenzuzo, lokukhokha
points: Vumelanani ngemali yokukhokha (USD/ZiG/okunye) lesheduli yokukhokha ezivumelwaneni.
Chaza kuhle i-dividend kanye lendlela yokuphuma kubahlanganyeli bama-diaspora.
Sebenzisa imizila yamabhanga evumelana lomthetho elokulandela konke ukuthengiselana.
Faka izimiso zengozi ye-FX lokudlulisa imali kuma-term sheet okutshalwa kwemali.

export_controls.title: Ukulawulwa kokuthumela phandle
points: Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kwe-HS, imingcele yemakethe yokufikela lezimvumo.
Gcina iphakethe lezitifiketi: imvelaphi, ezempilo yezitshalo, lemibhalo yekhwalithi.
Qondanisa ukulebhula, ukupakisha, lokulandela umkhondo lemigomo yemakethe yokufikela.
Sebenzisa abathuthi le-customs broker abavunyiweyo kumikhakha elawulwayo.

export_certification_and_labeling.title: Izitifiketi lokulebhula
points: Hlela umkhiqizo ngamunye uye kumazinga afunekayo ngaphambi kokwamukela umthengi.
Hlola kuqala izindawo zokukhiqiza lemibhalo ngaphambi kokuhlolwa kwezitifiketi zangaphandle.
Gcina ukulandela umkhondo we-lot yezokudla, wellness, lemisebenzi yezandla ethunyelwa phandle.
Yenza ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kokuhambisana ukuvikela ukuvalelwa emingceleni lezijeziso.

tourism_entry_and_safety.title: Ukungena kwezokwethekelela lokuphepha
points: Hlola uhlobo lwe-visa, isikhathi sokuhlala esivunyelweyo, lokusebenza kwemibhalo ngaphambi kohambo.
Phatha i-insurance yohambo ehambelana lemisebenzi ohlela ukuyenza lezidingo zezempilo.
Qinisekisa imizila yokukhokha lemikhawulo yokuthengiselana kusenesikhathi.
Landela imithetho yendawo yamapaki, imigwaqo, lezindawo zokuhlala.

due_diligence_checklist.title: Uhlu lwe-Due Diligence lwama-diaspora
points: Ukuqinisekiswa kwebhizinisi, ukuhlolwa kwe-UBO, lokuhlolwa kwamacala kumbe izijeziso.
Ukuhlolwa kwezivumelwano kwezentengiselwano, intela, lokuxazulula impikiswano.
Ubufakazi bokusebenza: ukuvakatsha indawo, ama-financials ahlolwe ngama-auditor, lokuqinisekisa abahlinzeki.
Ukulawula okuqhubekayo: isheduli yemibiko, ukulandelela ama-KPI, lematrix yokwenyusa udaba.

terms.p1: Ngokusebenzisa le nkundla, uyavuma ukunikeza ulwazi olunembile futhi uthobela imithetho esebenzayo yezezimali neyohwebo.
terms.p2: Konke okuqukethwe kokutshalwa kwezimali kunolwazi futhi akuhlanganisi iseluleko somuntu siqu ngezezimali.
terms.p3: Ukufinyelela kwenkundla kungase kumiswe okwesikhashana ngenxa yokuhlukumeza, ukukhwabanisa, noma ukwephulwa kwenqubomgomo.

privacy.title: Inqubomgomo yobumfihlo
privacy.p1: Siqoqa idatha ye-akhawunti neyokusetshenziswa kuphela yokusebenzisa inkundla, ukunqanda ukukhwabanisa, nokusekelwa kwabasebenzisi.
privacy.p2: Idatha yakho icutshungulwa ngaphansi kwemithetho esebenzayo yokuvikela idatha futhi ayithengiselwa izinkampani zangaphandle.
